card.title: Carry This with Me
card.instruction: Get someone to share a burden by framing participation as part of the relationship.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me sort our letters before the removal van comes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You kept them. I thought you'd want the box.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We filled it over ten years. I shouldn't have to decide alone what survives us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take the box. I just can't read them today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose a day we'll open it together. Taking it away can't mean you inherit all the deciding.

mechanism: A frames sorting old letters as a shared burden of the relationship, not ownership of the storage box.
confusable: Unlike passing unwanted possessions away, A must keep both people involved in deciding what survives.
comparison: D77-b resists B taking all deciding with the box; D77-a resists being the sole paperwork child.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
